description: Katastar.ba is the web portal of the Federal Administration for Geodetic and Property Affairs (FGU) of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, one of the two entities of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The pages read on 2026-09-28 show that the geoportal web viewer requires users to log in with a registered account, and the site menu lists available data and terms of use, a public view of cadastral data and the status of cadastral cases, the RCN register of real-estate prices, and WMS, WFS and WCS web services; the round 1 lead points to orthophotos and cadastral maps. Coverage is the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Access is free with registration for the viewer; the licence and the conditions for the web services were not read. Caveats: the entity of Republika Srpska has its own cadastre authority, layer lists and dates were not visible without login, and the portal is in local languages. It supports reference layers for hazard exposure studies, such as parcels, buildings and imagery for flood and landslide mapping. No related Bosnian cadastre record is catalogued; OpenStreetMap buildings complement it.
